incidents.failure: A combined closeout startup probe timed out before returning Git status, exact head, or exact-path inventory evidence.
incidents.recovery: Split the probe into independently bounded exact-head, tracked-delta, and declared-untracked-path checks with a larger bounded window.

incidents.failure: A second broad discovery probe combined script inventory and recursive Method Flow search and timed out before returning evidence.
incidents.recovery: Use exact known paths and a phase-root-scoped file listing rather than recursive multi-purpose discovery.

incidents.failure: A Windows PowerShell 5.1 probe piped directly from a statement-level foreach block and failed at parse time.
incidents.recovery: Assign the foreach result to an array before serializing it through the pipeline.

incidents.failure: The first closeout-candidate validator stopped on a child test failure while its checked subprocess wrapper suppressed the captured child diagnostics.
incidents.recovery: Run only the exact failing child selection with visible output before changing validation scope.

incidents.failure: The isolated historical x1-only test was incorrectly executed against the advanced x2 descendant and failed its required absence-of-surfaces assertion.
incidents.recovery: Bind historical x1-only credit to the immutable x1 commit receipt and run only current x2 and closeout tests on the descendant.

incidents.failure: The narrowed closeout validator recurred on the capture-only subprocess defect and hid the failing closeout child diagnostics.
incidents.recovery: Replace capture-only checked execution with an explicit nonzero exception that includes bounded stdout and stderr.

incidents.failure: The isolated closeout selection returned two errors because manifest preparation overwrote the semantic final receipt with a self-exclusion placeholder.
incidents.recovery: Keep the final receipt self-excluded from its manifest while preserving its already-written semantic payload.

incidents.failure: A nested inline Python diagnostic-guard witness was corrupted by PowerShell quoting and failed before the intended Python self-test ran.
incidents.recovery: Expose an explicit bounded diagnostic self-test option inside the validator instead of nesting executable source through the shell.

incidents.failure: The first postcommit canonical validator stopped at import because it requested phase constants from the preregistration builder module rather than the phase-data module.
incidents.recovery: Import the shared phase-data module directly and require an import-only witness before a new exact-final attempt.
